generic_reciprocal_weight_test.proof: Take all s=pi(N)-1 response primes, rho_q=eta log(q), eta=min(1/4,131L/(51200s)). The certified cost is feasible. Since s~N/log N, eta*log N->0. For large T rho_q<=1, and the sign-mixture weight obeys sum_{nu in Z^S}1/W(nu)=product_q sum_n sech(2rho_q n)>= (1+2/cosh(2))^s, which diverges. Thus |K|<=1 alone gives no uniform summable majorant. This does not show the actual K-weighted dual mass diverges or that another measure fails.
